scope: Regression examples do not limit corpus search

cases.evidence: The user reports completion of the Polar Sea test and migration after roughly five minutes; stalls were observed with other bases
cases.limits: The test supports the migration hypothesis; the AI has not been decompiled. The Tower rebuilt from 65016 needs a separate test.

cases.evidence: An identical map ID does not guarantee lower-area availability; the requested base contains Teostra/Lunastra/Rukodiora
cases.rule: Preserve the map package and use the Rukodiora spawn as a terrain reference, not proof of Toa AI compatibility

cases.limits: Do not infer animation or timers from the Damage threshold alone

cases.evidence: The user reports both crashing and non-crashing variants
cases.limits: A server EOF does not identify the client-side cause; compare exact revisions and granular tests
